Students with Disabilities

Disability Resources and Services (DRS) offers several scholarships. Students must be registered with DRS to apply for these scholarships. Scholarships may be used for tuition and related expenses, tutoring, assistive technology, internships, and other disability-related expenses unless otherwise indicated. More information can be found here: DRS Scholarships

Ambler Students

A full list of scholarships and deadlines can be found on the Temple University Ambler website.
